You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

translations.web: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
translations.bsb: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
translations.kjv: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
translations.asv: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me and set me in a large place.
